course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: 77 in the form, 90 in an argument: what each directive sees
goal: Separate form context, no-context server calculation and client interaction.

prerequisites.text: onec.p7; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.

sections.title: A question before observation
paragraphs: The form contains 77 minutes, but a call with 90 returns 1.5 hours. This difference is intentional: a context-free method needs its explicit input, not accidental window state.

sections.title: Directives select execution context
paragraphs: AtClient selects client execution; AtServer uses the form’s server context; AtServerNoContext does not automatically receive it. Method names do not select execution location. Compiler and runtime availability follow actual directives and module type.

One complete module demonstrates three boundaries. &НаКлиенте manages messages/dialogs; &НаСервере СверитьБуфер uses form data; &НаСервереБезКонтекста ЧасыНаСервере consumes only its numeric input. Directives express dependencies rather than decoration.

sections.title: Continue your own form
paragraphs: Continue your own separate copy with Клиенты, Услуги and ЗаявкаУслуги. The code belongs in the managed УчебнаяФормаЗаявки module, not a common module or startup handler. The form already contains Объект. Append only missing methods; do not duplicate existing definitions or load a full CF over your work.

In the form attributes add ИтогОпыта: String(120) and ВерсияЗапроса: Number(10,0). These belong to the form, not the document. The duplicate-reply task additionally needs ОбработаннаяВерсия and РасчетовОпыта: Number(10,0), initially 0.

In the form editor create the command ПоказатьДирективы, select its existing procedure as the action, and place it on the command bar. Append Команда.bsl to the same form module; do not generate a duplicate empty procedure. Link ПроверитьСтоимость similarly for the independent task.

Worked setup: open your own saved 30-minute request. For buffer/directive observations set 77 without saving; the callback command sets 90 and version 2 itself. The server experiment explicitly supplies 90, 1441, and the string “90”.

sections.title: Methods for the worked experiment
paragraphs: Only methods needed for this experiment are shown. If a previous topic already added a method, retain its single definition. The course retains the original complete module.

sections.title: The client command and its actual output
paragraphs: With &НаСервере, СверитьБуфер reads form data and the persisted reference. With &НаСервереБезКонтекста, ЧасыНаСервере receives 90 and returns 1.5 independently of the buffer’s 77. The client command displays these observations.

sections.title: No-context calls need explicit inputs
paragraphs: A pure calculation can use a no-context server method with explicit minutes/rate. Reading form attributes there reveals a hidden dependency to remove. Passing the whole form is not parameter design. A no-context call alone does not prove speedup without data-volume measurements.

The no-context function cannot read Объект. Minutes suffice, so avoid passing an entire document. Persisted reading needs a separate keyed function with appropriate rights. Minimal inputs simplify testing and reduce accidental state transfer.

sections.title: Predict before running
paragraphs: Which input does the context-free method use to calculate hours?
sections.reveal: 90. The directive determines available context; the argument supplies this call’s data. Matching field names do not transfer the form into a context-free function.

sections.title: Use context deliberately
paragraphs: A form-state operation may legitimately need context. Do not move everything toNoContext as a slogan. Separate data acquisition, pure computation and UI updates. A matrix shows what can be tested without a window and what actually requires form state.

Check Thin client, Server and Thick managed client compilation. This checks name/context availability, not an actual network installation. An ordinary run separately verifies 90 → 1.5 and rejection of 1441.

sections.title: Follow the source and action boundary
paragraphs: Reading and calculation are independent: 77 does not become the supplied 90. This maps responsibilities; it does not count network packets.

flow.caption: Reading and calculation are independent: 77 does not become the supplied 90. This maps responsibilities; it does not count network packets.

sections.title: The mistake this experiment distinguishes
paragraphs: Reading Объект inside a context-free function introduces a hidden form dependency. In a separate experimental copy, compilation should report the unavailable name. Keep explicit arguments in your working version.

sections.title: Include a wrong-context check
paragraphs: Compare two calculation versions with identical explicit inputs. In an experimental copy, access a form attribute fromNoContext and detect the dependency. Do not hide it in a global variable. Test missing input and repeats so prior form state cannot influence the next result.

In another source copy intentionally read Объект inside the no-context function, retain the diagnostic and restore the argument. Do not fix it with Privileged or by moving all database work to the client; that changes the trust boundary.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Write СтоимостьРаботы(Минуты,Тариф) under &НаСервереБезКонтекста. Reuse ЧасыНаСервере to validate minutes; the rate must be a nonnegative number. Return hours × rate. Regardless of other minutes in the form, (45,800) must return 600; reject a negative rate. Preserve earlier methods without moving or duplicating them.
Preserve your prediction and code before viewing the reference. The worked example does not solve this new task. Viewing its files does not replace your work.
